invalidation_rules: invalidate if the PCB, fixture, or tray is touched or moved
invalidate after collision, emergency stop, or unexpected contact
invalidate a pick target after that frozen tray item is consumed
recapture after a failed grasp or uncertain part identity
recapture both TrayHome and SMDView after any CAP moves in the tray

rules: Every frozen part must carry detector-generated median quality metrics.
A complete count never overrides a low-confidence or malformed mask.
Any quality failure blocks snapshot creation and forces a fresh tray measurement.
